entries.why: A Rego policy can call the builtin http.send, so policy text reaching an OPA evaluator is an outbound-request sink inside the dependency.
entries.safe_option: rego.Capabilities with http.send removed from the builtin set

entries.why: CEL evaluates caller-supplied expression text against a host environment, so the environment's exposed functions become reachable sinks.
entries.safe_option: cel.NewEnv restricted to a reviewed declaration list, with no host function that performs IO

entries.why: Starlark executes caller-supplied script text; every predeclared builtin the host installs is reachable from that script.
entries.safe_option: A predeclared StringDict that exposes no IO builtin, with load() disabled

entries.why: goja runs caller-supplied JavaScript in-process; any Go value set on the runtime is callable from that script.
entries.safe_option: A runtime with no Set() of a host object, plus an interrupt deadline

entries.why: gopher-lua executes caller-supplied Lua; the default standard library exposes os and io functions.
entries.safe_option: lua.NewState with SkipOpenLibs and an explicit allowlist of opened libraries

entries.why: Jinja2 compiles caller-supplied template text; attribute traversal from a template reaches Python objects unless the sandboxed environment is used.
